dimensions.assessment: Affects energy sector entities, pipeline operators, liquefied natural gas facilities, and federal/state agencies involved in infrastructure security.
dimensions.evidence: natural gas pipelines (including natural gas transmission and distribution pipelines), hazardous liquid pipelines, and liquefied natural gas facilities

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a voluntary assistance, coordination, pilot project, and workforce development program without imposing mandatory federal security regulations on private operators.
dimensions.evidence: to develop, for voluntary use, advanced cybersecurity applications and technologies... to perform pilot demonstration projects

dimensions.assessment: No specific spending amounts or appropriations are authorized or mentioned in the source text.
Directs the creation of a comprehensive Department of Energy program covering policies, coordination, pilot projects, workforce training, and technical tools.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary of Energy... shall carry out a program-- (1) to establish policies and procedures that improve coordination...

dimensions.assessment: Establishes an ongoing program directive for the Department of Energy.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary of Energy... shall carry out a program

importance_detail.rationale: Directs the Department of Energy to establish a program for physical security and cybersecurity for pipelines and liquefied natural gas facilities.
